final: WITH step3 AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) as distinct_trans_count, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) AS REAL) / 999 as ratio FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref GROUP BY t.tradekind), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio FROM step3) SELECT s3.tradekind, s3.distinct_trans_count, s3.ratio, s3.ratio - s4.avg_ratio as difference FROM step3 s3 CROSS JOIN step4 s4 WHERE s3.ratio > s4.avg_ratio ORDER BY s3.tradekind
